variants: 新品未開封|未開封品|シュリンク付き
meaning_en: Factory sealed. Highest collector grade for figures and kuji prizes.

variants: 開封済み|開封のみ|開封品
meaning_en: Box was opened; item typically displayed or inspected. Usually still complete.

variants: 箱無し|外箱なし|本体のみ
meaning_en: Original packaging missing. Fine for display; lowers resale value noticeably.

variants: 箱に傷|箱ダメージ|箱イタミ
meaning_en: Packaging dented or scuffed; item itself usually unaffected.

variants: 難有り|訳あり|ワケあり
meaning_en: Seller declares a defect. Ask what exactly is wrong before buying.
risk_flag: Ask seller for photos of the defect

variants: ジャンク品
meaning_en: Sold without guarantee of function or completeness. Parts may be missing.

variants: 中古品|USED
meaning_en: Generic secondhand label. Says nothing about grade by itself.

variants: 当時品
meaning_en: Original release from the period rather than a re-release. Can raise value for older lines.

variants: 再販品|再版
meaning_en: A later production run. Usually cheaper than original run; check which run the listing is.

variants: プライズ品|クレーンゲーム景品
meaning_en: Arcade/crane-game item. Lower MSRP tier than scale figures; not a defect.

variants: 正規|公式
meaning_en: Seller asserts authenticity. Not proof by itself.
risk_flag: Verify maker name and packaging text

variants: 海外版|海外正規品
meaning_en: May be a legitimate regional release or a bootleg. Needs verification.
risk_flag: Check maker and JAN against catalog

variants: ノーブランド品
meaning_en: No manufacturer stated. Strong bootleg indicator for character goods.

variants: まとめ売り|まとめ|セット売り
meaning_en: Multiple items sold together. Resolve each item separately if possible.

variants: バラ不可
meaning_en: Bundle only; cannot buy a single item from the lot.

variants: 箱only|外箱のみ
meaning_en: Only the original packaging is offered; the figure or prize itself is not included. Value is limited to display or storage use.
risk_flag: Confirm the actual item is NOT included

variants: 内袋未開封品|インナー袋未開封
meaning_en: Outer box may be opened but the inner poly bag protecting the piece is still sealed. Near-mint condition for loose or blind-packed items.

variants: 下げ札付き|タグ付|ネームタグ付き
meaning_en: Original hang tag or fabric tag is still attached. Common quality marker for plush and apparel; missing tags can lower value.

variants: 初回限定|初回版|初回封入特典付き
meaning_en: The original production run
price_effect: often bundled with a first-print bonus. Later reprints usually lack this bonus even if the main item is identical.

variants: 予約特典付き|購入特典付き|特典あり
meaning_en: Includes a store or preorder bonus item that is not part of the base product. Ask exactly which bonus is included and whether it is store-exclusive.
risk_flag: Ask seller exactly which bonus is included

variants: 帯付き|帯あり|OBI付き
meaning_en: Japanese CD/media obi (the promotional paper strip around the case) is present and intact. Collectors value complete-obi condition highly.

variants: 美品|状態良好
meaning_en: Seller's subjective claim of good condition; not a standardized grade. Ask for photos to confirm.

variants: 台座あり|台座付
meaning_en: The display stand or base that ships with the figure is included. Some secondhand listings separate the stand from the figure.
risk_flag: Confirm stand is the original one for this SKU

variants: 動作確認済|通電確認済み
meaning_en: Seller states an electronic or mechanical item (light-up parts
